# Document the settled report layout

Several items in this epic change what the settlement report emits — its columns, the data behind
those columns, and what it says at the end about the records it rejected. The documentation still
describes the layout as it was before any of them.

Once **every** item that changes the report has landed, bring the documentation into line with what
the emitter actually produces:

- update the report-rendering rows of `TESTING.md` so they describe the settled layout,
- update `CLAUDE.md`'s description of `artifacts/report.golden.txt` if the artifact's shape changed.

This item exists to keep the documentation from drifting away from the artifact. It waits on all of
those items rather than on any one of them: documenting against a layout that a later item then
changes is the same drift, produced earlier.
